model.adapter_truth: TransformerLMIntegration is the concrete integration; HiddenStateAdapter is synthetic and excluded

data.fit_scope: all transforms fit train rows only; MLP may use validation labels for early stopping; held-out test labels are never used for fitting or model selection

split.group_conflict: fail if one prompt digest maps to multiple labels
split.overlap_assertion: zero digest overlap between every pair of partitions

prompt_contract.tokenization: TransformerLMIntegration backend tokenizer, padding=True, truncation=True, return_tensors=pt
prompt_contract.truncation_policy: fail if any prompt is truncated

baseline_contract.raw_glyph: flattened 8x8 pixels with the same fixed grouped split and train-only standardization
baseline_contract.role: diagnostic only; GPT-2 hidden states need not outperform the input glyph representation
baseline_contract.rationale: pixels directly retain glyph morphology while GPT-2 was not trained for this synthetic ASCII task

controls.shuffled_label: permute train labels only; preserve fixed true validation/test labels
controls.wilson_interval: 95% Wilson score interval for primary held-out accuracy
controls.api_diagnostic: nonlinear_memorization_test shuffles all labels and re-splits; report only as API shuffled-label diagnostic, never as train memorization proof
controls.capacity: record n_params/n_train, validation accuracy, test accuracy, and absolute validation/test gap

records.predicate: full-hidden accuracy >= 0.20; PCA32 accuracy >= full-hidden accuracy - 0.10; PCA32 paired bootstrap lower > 0.05; Wilson lower > 0.15; all finite and no group overlap
full-hidden accuracy >= 0.20; paired B=10000 lower > 0.05; Wilson lower > 0.15; all finite and no group overlap
bounded primary MLP held-out accuracy >= 0.20; paired B=10000 lower > 0.05; shuffled-control <= 0.15; abs validation/test gap <= 0.15; n_params/n_train <= 4

artifact_contract.partial_promotion: independent record verdicts; dependency failures block downstream records; no D2 without accepted records

report_schema.stdout_encoding: one JSON object; artifact and preliminary run_record nested; no committed output files
report_schema.finalizer: preliminary failure or success report is validated before finalization; wrapper evidence requires checkout_removed/cache_removed/output_captured=true, isolated_checkout_path, isolated_cache_paths, captured_output_sha256, wrapper_exit_status=0; preserves artifact bytes and accepted IDs

provenance_contract.model_provenance: model ID, immutable revision, official pinned URL, MIT license URL, tokenizer/config fields
provenance_contract.runtime: Python, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, Torch, Transformers, CUDA versions
provenance_contract.resources: GPU identity, CUDA/Torch versions, token distribution, inference batch size/count, peak allocated/reserved memory, host RSS when /usr/bin/time is available; otherwise explicitly not measured
provenance_contract.cleanup: disposable clone and model/package caches removed by trap after report capture; distinguish runner measurements from wrapper cleanup evidence

phase_contract.phase_a: commit/push plan, runner, support modules, finalizer, tests; no result artifact
phase_contract.phase_b: external authenticated PowerShell launches Bash/SSH remote-cuda skill against exact pushed SHA; runner emits preliminary JSON with cleanup pending; wrapper captures exact bytes and proves isolated checkout/cache/output cleanup
phase_contract.phase_c: side-effect-free finalizer validates preliminary success or failed report and cleanup evidence, emits final immutable run record without changing artifact metrics/IDs; finalizer handles failed runs too; cleanup evidence identifies only the isolated checkout/cache paths, captured output digest, and wrapper exit status; separate evidence/docs promotion commit only after owner review
